intro:
Can you pick the “normal” answer?
Dark mind teasers await
Unmask the hidden choice!
description:
Does your answer seem as ordinary as you think?

Take on a slightly dark psychological quiz built around chilling situations. Study each image, choose from the options, and try to spot the line of thought that feels just a little different from the usual response.

Playing is easy!
・Study the image
・Think about what you would do
・Choose one answer from four options

“Why would someone act like that?”
“What were they thinking in that moment?”
The reveal behind each answer may give you a little shiver.

No complicated steps needed. It is quick to play in short sessions, great for thinking things through on your own or guessing with friends by asking, “Which one would you pick?”

Recommended for anyone who likes:
・Psychology quizzes and mind teasers
・Unexpected answers and tricky questions
・Testing deduction and intuition
・Quick quizzes for spare moments
・A slightly dark theme

Are you with the majority?
Or will you land on the answer no one else saw coming?
Think it through and challenge every question.
